gaps.note: The page asserts that the paper's middle transform, with its target permutation, becomes a normalized cyclic convolution by this identity. The reader does not know what the middle transform is in the paper and cannot check the reduction from what the page gives.

gaps.term: convolution form of the sum over j

gaps.note: The page does not say which two sequences are convolved, nor that the chirp w^{-(k-j)^2} is periodic in k-j modulo q so that the index arithmetic is cyclic. Since k-j can be negative, the reader cannot verify the convolution form from the identity alone.
